FAQ

Does shipping Journal Suggestions auto-translate my China listing?

No. Journal Suggestions, suggested moments, and contextual writing prompts are on-device Journal behaviors — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. Empty or English zh-Hans fields mean China buyers see en-US fallback even when your US listing mentions Journal Suggestions or 日记建议.

How is this different from the general Journal / diary hub listing copy?

Journal hub markets the diary product as a whole — daily entries, gratitude lists, private diary covers, start-today's-entry onboarding — 日记 and 日记本. Journal Suggestions markets suggested moments and contextual writing prompts that propose what to write about — 日记建议, 建议时刻, 书写提示. Filling a blank page with a suggested moment is different from opening a diary hub without a suggestion.

How is this different from Journal Reflections?

Journal Reflections markets scheduled prompts that help users revisit past entries — 日记反思, 回顾日记. Journal Suggestions markets suggested moments for a new entry — photos, places, workouts, outings — 日记建议. Look-backs on a schedule are not contextual writing prompts for what to journal about next.

The Journaling Suggestions guide markets third-party Save to Journal / Reflect in Journal donor badges into Apple Journal. This page markets Journal Suggestions / suggested moments / contextual writing prompts as the product-page lead story — 日记建议 — including Apple Journal Suggestions education and companion framing.
